_what: DATA for tool:see-my-decisions (read-data/work-screen.mjs), the Decisions/Home screen read. `records` names the person's own rows it reads (each one the row's rights name); of their one Checks list (`method_checks`) it reads only the step rows (`step_rows`: the door's `where` and `fields`), whose `check` is a decision step's question text, so a word-check row, a piece or a branch never shows as a question and the 4096-row bound counts step rows alone. `limit` is the decisions, pursuits and plans on one page (the old screen's 100); `most_*` bound every whole-history read, past which the read refuses and names native_collection_page. `scope` is the part of the old app's src/record-scope.json and src/record-sharing.json the pursuit tree reads: its one dimension, the refs it names and the links whose `from` is a pursuit (none today, so a pursuit's parents come only from the person's own record-scope choice rows). `pursuits` is the screen's words for a person with no pursuits (src/screen-words.json pursuits). Moved from trillion-rust product/record-scope.json, product/record-sharing.json and product/screen-words.json, which leave the engine with their reader.

pursuits.none: Every decision is weighed against what you are working toward and what it changes beyond you. Tell your AI, and it adds it for you.
pursuits.measured: Decisions made while Trillion knew what the person was working toward worked {with} of the time, against {without} for the rest (at least {people} people in each group). Tell your AI what you are working toward, and it adds it for you.

words.input: Send an object: { metadata_only?, native_collection_page?, before?, access?, allowance?, space_pursuits? }.
words.before: before is the created_at the last page answered as next_before: a string of at most {most} characters.
words.access: access is what your place reports: { capabilities: [names], limits?: { [access]: [{ count, per }] } }.
words.allowance: allowance is what your place reports: { count, per, used }, whole numbers and a period word.
words.allowance_needed: Your access limits deciding, so send the allowance your place reports: { count, per, used }.
words.space_pursuits: space_pursuits is a list of the pursuits your spaces share.
words.too_many: More than {most} {what} rows: ask for one bounded page instead (native_collection_page: true).
